request.problem: The repository can describe Personas, Skills, Tools, and workflows, but it needs controlled evidence about how those contracts behave across LLMs and assistant surfaces.
request.desired_outcome: A concise conformance suite and an observing Persona that record successes, failures, ambiguity, friction, access gaps, and safety concerns without inventing runtime evidence.
non_goals: Private source material in the public repository
constraints: Use existing Persona, Docs, Work Order, and collaboration structures
Keep the first validation set concise
Preserve unknown runtime and identity questions
success_criteria: The same normalized result contract can be evaluated across surfaces
Findings distinguish model behavior from access or setup failure
The observer Persona has attributable workflows and a usable Work Order log
request.stopping_condition: The suite, observer Persona, observation template, validation results, limitations, and follow-up work are linked and reviewable.

participants.responsibility: Confirm the existing Persona, Docs, Work Order, and eval destinations
Define evaluation boundaries, prepare comparable conditions, and invoke Noor for every evaluated run
Check routing, capability conditions, permissions, and safe fallback behavior
Observe and classify every evaluated run after Riley prepares the comparable run packet

evidence.supports: Observer Persona and Work Order requirements

evidence.source: Sanitized authorized run bundles in eval/results/authorized-runs
evidence.supports: Five ten-fixture surface runs; Cursor includes an independently observed Noor handoff, while behavioral parity remains unknown

contributions.finding: eval/ is the smallest repository-local home, Work Orders are the active observation record, and no new top-level library space is needed.
tradeoffs_or_risks: A future provider adapter may need a narrower Tool boundary.
contributions.recommended_action: Keep the first implementation file-based and route any adapter expansion through a later review.

contributions.finding: Riley should coordinate evaluation and improvement while Noor owns conformance observation; the portable evaluation Skill remains shared, but Riley’s per-run route must invoke Noor.
tradeoffs_or_risks: Repository data can declare the handoff but cannot prove that every runtime enforces it.
contributions.recommended_action: Use the required Riley-to-Noor handoff for every evaluated run and record an access-gap or unknown when Noor is unavailable.

contributions.finding: Model, surface, context, Tool, permission, and unavailable-condition fields are required so access gaps remain separate from model behavior.
tradeoffs_or_risks: Recorded results remain incomplete when a surface cannot expose its trace.
contributions.recommended_action: Require the condition fields in every adapter and classify missing visibility as access-gap or unknown.

contributions.finding: The observer contract records fixture behavior separately from observer availability and conformance status, so a valid response shape cannot be mistaken for independent conformance.
tradeoffs_or_risks: Only the Cursor follow-up supplied an independently available Noor observer; provider parity remains unknown.
contributions.recommended_action: Use the compact independent-handoff record as the completion evidence and defer provider infrastructure unless needed.

decisions.summary: Use existing Persona and flow catalogs, eval/ for file-based conformance, and Work Orders for active observations; create no new top-level library space.

Keep Noor Vale as the conformance and workflow-observability owner. Riley Morgan coordinates the run and must invoke Noor for every evaluated run; the shared Evaluation and observability Skill is applied to Noor for conformance and to Riley only through orchestration coordination.
Implement a recorded-result adapter and normalized evaluator before provider-specific live adapters are authorized.
